title: NoRaining
body:
# No More Rain Particles Mod

A simple Minecraft mod that removes rain particles while keeping the rain weather itself fully intact.

![noraining preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f9932979290558adab0d0d66beadc766034de54.png)

## What it does

This mod disables the visual rain particles so your screen stays clean during rainy weather. The world will still look darker and behave like normal rain, but you won’t see the constant falling drops.

## Why use it

It’s useful if you want better visibility, less visual clutter, or smoother performance during rain. Some players also prefer the cleaner look while exploring or building.

## Features

- Removes rain particle effects
- Keeps rain weather and mechanics unchanged
- Lightweight and client-side friendly
- No impact on gameplay systems like farming or mob behavior
